title: M8: Delivery — CI, releases, and deploy
description: Intent: As the maintainer, I want green specs gating merges and automatic releases, so that main is always shippable. Includes: GitHub Actions running npm test, commitlint on PRs, Semantic Release on main, deploy workflow (CDK diff on PR, deploy on release), web hosting on S3+CloudFront or Amplify. Excludes: multi-environment promotion. DoD: a merged feat commit produces a tagged release and a deployed site.
right_now_summary: The release workflow will tag minor releases, update the changelog, and deploy the site and backend.
